lines.text: Autonomous coding agents are rewriting software engineering. But give an agent your personal Git token, and one hallucinated push can wipe out production.
Traditional Git platforms were built fifteen years ago for humans in web browsers. They have no ref isolation, bottleneck parallel swarms, and treat agents like untrusted intruders.
Meet exist.io: the sovereign, self-hosted Git forge engineered from first principles for autonomous coding agents and human teams.
Instead of static credentials, agents request ephemeral HMAC-SHA256 capability leases. Every write is strictly isolated to agent branch namespaces. Zero privilege escalation.
With a native Model Context Protocol server mounting thirty-five tools, agents search AST symbols and open PRs effortlessly, while pre-receive hooks kill secret leaks before commits hit disk.
Pure Go. Zero host dependencies. Deploy in under five minutes with existd bootstrap, and give your coding agents a forge of their own.
